# GEO + SEO Review

Use this workflow when reviewing or improving this website for search visibility.

## Goals
- Improve discoverability in AI-powered search assistants and traditional search engines.
- Preserve truthful, useful content and avoid keyword stuffing or fabricated authority signals.
- Prefer concrete site improvements over speculative ranking claims.

## Review areas
1. AI citability: concise service explanations, self-contained factual passages, descriptive headings, clear answers to common business questions.
2. Brand/entity clarity: consistent RJ Digital Solutions name, service offering, contact details, portfolio links, and official social/profile links.
3. AI crawler access: inspect robots.txt for accidental blocking of legitimate search/AI crawlers.
4. llms.txt: recommend or generate only when useful; keep it factual and aligned with the actual site.
5. Structured data: valid Organization, ProfessionalService, WebSite, Service, BreadcrumbList, and FAQ only when matching visible content exists.
6. Technical SEO: title, meta description, canonical, sitemap, robots.txt, HTTPS, mobile usability, performance, internal linking, image alt text.
7. Content quality: specific service descriptions, real case studies/portfolio evidence, freshness, clear trust/contact information.
8. Local/business discoverability: consistent business identity and contact details wherever publicly listed.

## Rules
- Never invent client names, testimonials, awards, case-study metrics, addresses, ratings, certifications, or schema fields.
- Do not add FAQ schema unless the matching FAQ content is visibly present.
- Do not add fake location pages or doorway pages.
- Keep human usability, accessibility, and clarity ahead of search-engine tricks.
- Explain significant SEO/GEO changes and verify they do not break the existing site.

## Before delivery
- Check titles/descriptions are unique and relevant.
- Check canonical URLs and sitemap/robots references.
- Validate JSON-LD syntax and factual accuracy.
- Check mobile layout, image optimization, and page speed basics.
- Check internal links, service pages, portfolio/case-study links, and calls to action.
- Summarize what changed, what was verified, and what requires owner confirmation.

Inspired by the open-source geo-seo-claude workflow from zubair-trabzada/geo-seo-claude.
